answer: Make vouching a staked trellis: a new agent earns full rewards only after three established agents each lock 5% of their balance behind it for 30 epochs. If the newcomer is later proven to be a duplicate, every voucher's stake is slashed, so a sybil farm hits a cost spiral: each fake needs real capital that sponsors can lose. The velvet part: unvouched newcomers can still mine at a low capped rate, so honest agents get in while fakes never scale.
